title: Correcting what Chef Mealan read: his checks first, then my words, and by hand on the Plate
short: A read is corrected in three ways, each with one job: his checks, my words, and by hand on the Plate
rel: Proposed; not agreed until Coach Milan says Go
boardTitle: DT318: correcting what Chef Mealan read. His checks first, then my words, and by hand on the Plate

opportunity.from: Coach Milan, 18 November 2026, 19:26, from a photo he logged; and 21:48 with a screenshot of a tester's read.
opportunity.job: Make the list of foods right after a read, quickly, so the meal I log is the meal I ate.
opportunity.kind: Several doors, each doing part of the job: a tap on a chip, Change the foods, a swipe, a link to a form, and Chef Mealan's own question. None says which to use.
opportunity.why_now: Every read ends here. B150 changes the same screen, so both are tested once.

problem: After the read I got a nice list of foods. Chef Mealan asked about the chicken and I chose 200 g. The yogurt was fixed at 10% fat, which I saw only in the food list, not on the chip. I tried to swap it, but there was no 0.2% yogurt. So I told Chef Mealan: it was 0.2% yogurt, and there was mayo. He read again and asked about the chicken a second time, now 220 g. The list was right in the end, but where and how to correct it was confusing.
story: When a read is not quite right, I want one place to correct the foods, with my hands or with my words, so that I do not hunt for the right door and nothing I set is lost.
words: 18 November 19:26: jogurt was with 10% fixed in the food list, not on the read chip. I tried to swap for 0.2% fat but such jogurt was not listed. I added info as mayo was not recognized and said that I had 0.2% fat jogurt. Then it asked me again about the chicken, this time if it was 220 g. A bit confusing where and how to update it.
cause: Replayed on the app as built in 0.3.159. The chip shows a short name, so 10% fat is cut off. The question about an amount is not on the read; it is on the screen behind Change the foods. The swap list offers foods from my own list. And a second read starts from the photo again: it drops the amount I chose and asks anew.
words2: 19:43: better an edit mode where what is needed is set, than another way of correction. 21:48: saying it to Chef Mealan worked very well. So we have several places for making it better and each of them does some work. 23:33: editing chips is double work from the block where we edit foods anyway. A branch is drawn from its screen, or as a flow of its own. 23:44: select a chip and tell the chef what it is or is not; that is for using the chef for a second read. If correcting the read, send it to the Plate for editing. Keep the current few checks, where a pure guess is better than nothing. 23:53: Say it next to Read again makes it unclear. 23:56: no one is updating the foods. I want to see in the design drawn examples of the current reads as suggestions for initial correction, and if not correct or a wrong food, to offer to edit details or change the food in the food list on the Plate. 00:06: it is not just about editing on the Plate, it can be adding; so Continue on the Plate. 00:11: we test this solution; if we see the need to edit every chip before continuing on the Plate, we work on it then. 00:23: with Not right? on a check, what is the flow: which card, do we scroll down to edit and up for the others, what if only some are answered, and the button to the Plate is doubled. 00:24: the link goes. 00:32: are the options linked to a real product in our database? Once on the plate it should have the food label ready and the other macros included. 00:35: then propose the food from the database, not just 10%, 5%, 0.2%: yogurt Hildebrand 0.2% fat. 00:38: home made food is one selection of our food list; at other people's tables is another; a restaurant is a different read. 00:46: a new ticket for the smarter read. In DT318 keep the check that suggests similar foods: chicken or turkey or something else he will suggest, yogurt or cream, tuna or. One thing is the type of the food, then its properties, then the brand. We need to ensure the type and the kind, so when that is right, editing is easier. We can offer the same kind with some differences, like yogurt has with fat. 00:54: where is the block on 1a, 1b, 1c? And: what to check, not what is wrong; not necessarily something is wrong.
proposed: Three ways, each with one job, in this order. 1. His checks, on the read: the few questions Chef Mealan has today about an amount or a kind stand under the chips as the first correction, each with its answers and Skip. A food is settled in two steps. First what it is: he suggests similar foods, chicken or turkey, yogurt or sour cream, as he does today. Then which one: foods of that kind that differ, in fat for a yogurt, by their full name, my own first with its brand, then foods from the app's lists, a guess only when there is none. 2. My words, on the read: a tap on a chip marks it, and one field takes what I tell Chef Mealan about it, typed or said; with no chip marked, the field takes a missing food. The button says Send to Chef Mealan. 3. By hand: Continue on the Plate, the one way to the Plate, opens the food list, where an amount is typed, a food's details are opened, a food is changed or added. A check I did not answer goes with me and stands on the Plate, as today. The chips show the food's full name. What I set stays, and he does not ask about it a second time.
more_change: Four things change that are built today. 1. His checks show on the read; today they show only on the Plate's screen. 2. A tap on a chip marks it for Chef Mealan; today it turns the chip into a number. Grams are typed on the Plate. 3. Change the foods is named Continue on the Plate, and the link Wrong foods? Help Chef Mealan read it goes from the Plate's screen; its job is the field on the read. 4. After a check about what a food is, a second one asks which one, and its answers are real foods. Today Chef Mealan writes them himself, and an answer can land on the Plate as an estimate with five values and no label.
open: One thing for your word. The link Wrong foods? Help Chef Mealan read it sits on the Plate's screen today. I took it out, so words have one place. Say if it should stay.
days: The board is drawn on the app's test photo. The foods are yours: chicken, sweet potato fries, yogurt, mayonnaise.
unchanged: The photo, the title, the meal line, This plate and the end of the read.
Which checks Chef Mealan asks, and how many: as today.
The Plate's food list: grams, a food's details, the swipe to change or remove a food, + Add more to your plate, Fit to my target, Group into parts.
details: No new screen and no new editor.
Send to Chef Mealan sends the photos, my words, the food they are about, and what I set before. He keeps what I set.
One line from Chef Mealan says what he did.
A food he changed or added is marked on its chip until the next tap.
The microphone sits inside the field.
The doubled foods of a tester are B152, not this ticket.
Later, not in this ticket (DT321, parked): one pencil at the top right of the chips, so each chip can be tapped and its food edited in place, one by one, before moving to the Plate.

Where a kind's answers come from, in this order: my own food list, the members' foods, the app's table of basic foods. Chef Mealan picks from those. Only when none fits he offers a guess, and that answer and its chip say estimate.

Three layers of a food: its type (yogurt, not sour cream), its properties (0.2% fat), its brand. The first check settles the type, the second the rest. When both are right, little is left to edit on the Plate.
He asks about the type only when he cannot tell, as today. The question which one follows a type that has kinds that differ; for a plain food it does not come.
Where the meal was eaten (home, someone's home, a restaurant) is not part of this ticket: DT322.
The row DT318.1, steps 1 to 6, is the flow. There is no branch.
The field stands on the read from the start, under his checks. It does not wait for the checks to be answered.

ac.title: A chip shows the full name
ac.text: Given Chef Mealan read a photo, when I look under the photo, then each chip shows the food's full name and grams, such as Yogurt, 10% fat ~80 g.

ac.title: His checks stand on the read
ac.text: Given the read is not sure about an amount or a kind, when the read opens, then his question stands under the chips with its answers and Skip, as it does on the Plate today; and a check I do not answer still stands on the Plate when I continue there.

ac.title: A check about an amount
ac.text: Given the question is the chicken breast about 200 g or 350 g, when I tap ~200 g, then the chip says 200 g without the ~ and the question is gone.

ac.title: A check about what it is
ac.text: Given the question is it yogurt, sour cream or skyr, when I tap Yogurt, then the type is settled, and because yogurts differ he asks next which yogurt it is.

ac.title: A check about which one
ac.text: Given the question which yogurt is it, when I tap Hildebrand yogurt, 0.2% fat, then the chip says Hildebrand yogurt, 0.2% fat and the question is gone.

ac.title: The answers are real foods
ac.text: Given a check about which one, when it shows, then each answer is a food by its full name, my own foods of that kind first and marked yours, then foods from the app's lists that differ in a property such as fat; and the one I tap is on the Plate with its label and all its values.

ac.title: An estimate says so
ac.text: Given no food of that kind is in my list or the app's lists, when the check shows, then the answer is marked estimate, and so is its chip.

ac.title: My words, about a food
ac.text: Given I tapped the yogurt's chip, when I write what it is and tap Send to Chef Mealan, then the field said About: Yogurt, 10% fat, the chip shows what he changed, and one line from him says it.

ac.title: My words, a missing food
ac.text: Given no chip is marked, when I write There was mayo too and tap Send to Chef Mealan, then a chip Mayonnaise is there, marked as new.

ac.title: Said, not typed
ac.text: Given the field, when I tap the microphone in it and speak, then my words stand in the field as if typed.

ac.title: What I set stays
ac.text: Given I answered a check or typed an amount on the Plate, when Chef Mealan answers my words, then that food is as I set it and he does not ask about it again.

ac.title: By hand, on the Plate
ac.text: Given the read, when I tap Continue on the Plate, then the Plate opens with its food list as it is today, and there is no button Change the foods.

ac.title: One place for words
ac.text: Given the Plate with a photo, when I look at it, then there is no link Wrong foods? Help Chef Mealan read it.

ac.title: Three languages
ac.text: Given the app in English, Serbian or German, when I walk steps 1 to 6, then Tell Chef Mealan what to check, About, Send to Chef Mealan, Continue on the Plate and Chef Mealan's line are in that language.
